explanation: Lemma 2(d): the bound 2n² + 4n + 2 for blocks [2n+2, 4n+3] versus [1, 2n+1]. It is proved in Lean and is correct as a combinatorial lemma about sequences; it supports the paper's Lemma 1/2 counting argument. Source: Erdős–Fajtlowicz–Staton, 'Degree sequences in triangle-free graphs', Discrete Math. 92 (1991) 85–88. The full text was not accessible; the zbMATH review summary says that triangle-free graphs in which no degree occurs more than twice are bipartite, and that every triangle-free graph is an induced subgraph of one in which no degree occurs more than three times.
